rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose expression of forceful, vigorous, or powerful action.

example.traditional: 我哋一定要大力支持呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daai6 lik6 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this as the everyday intensifier for feeling or doing something very much, rather than for physical force.

example.english: I strongly recommend this restaurant to everyone.
example.traditional: 我好推介呢間餐廳畀大家。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 teoi1 gaai3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 bei2 daai6 gaa1
